current.instructions:
1. Lie on your side with your legs stacked, knees bent at about 90 degrees, and your hips aligned. Rest your head on your bottom arm and place your top hand on your hip for support.
2. Keep your feet together and your core engaged.
3. Raise your top knee upward as far as possible without rotating your hips or lifting your feet off each other. Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
4. Lower your knee back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
current.tips:
1. Keep your hips stacked and avoid rolling your body backward as you lift your knee.
2. Engage your core throughout to stabilize your torso.
3. Use slow, controlled movements to maintain constant tension on the muscles.

current.instructions:
1. Begin in a plank position with your hands close together under your chest, fingers forming a diamond shape (thumbs and index fingers touching).
2. Lower your body towards the floor, keeping your elbows close to your body and your back straight.
3. Pause briefly as your chest nearly touches your hands.
4. Push back up to the starting plank position, maintaining a straight line from your head to your heels throughout the movement.
current.tips:
1. Ensure your elbows do not flare out; they should stay close to your body to maximize triceps engagement.
2. Control your descent and ascent to increase muscle tension and enhance strength gains.
3. Breathe in as you lower down and exhale forcefully as you push back up to help power the movement.
4. Keep your head in a neutral position, aligned with your spine, to avoid neck strain.
5. Perform the push-up at a slow to moderate pace to focus on form and muscle engagement without rushing.

current.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your feet elevated on a box, with your knees bent at 90 degrees. Place a dumbbell on your hips and hold it securely with both hands for support.
2. Engage your glutes and press through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling, extending your hips until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
3. At the peak of the movement, squeeze your glutes and pause for a second.
4. Lower your hips with control to the starting position and repeat for the desired repetitions.
current.tips:
1. Ensure your feet are firm and secure on the elevated surface throughout the movement.
2. Focus on driving through your heels to maximize glute activation.
3. Keep the dumbbell balanced and stable on your hips; use a towel or pad for comfort if needed.

name: Dumbbell Feet Elevated Single Leg Glute Bridge

current.instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your feet elevated on a box, your left knee bent at about 90 degrees, and your right leg extended towards the ceiling. Place a dumbbell on your hips and hold it securely with both hands for support.
2. Engage your glutes and press through your heel to lift your hips toward the ceiling, extending your hips until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
3. At the peak of the movement, squeeze your glutes and pause for a second.
4. Lower your hips back down with control and repeat for the desired repetitions.
current.tips:
1. Ensure your feet are firm and secure on the elevated surface throughout the movement.
2. Focus on driving through your heels to maximize glute activation.
3. Keep the dumbbell balanced and stable on your hips; use a towel or pad for comfort if needed.
